chunks.arabic_text: أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ أَخُو عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْفَارِسِيِّ الْمُتَقَدِّمِ ذِكْرُهُ.

translations.en: Abu Muhammad, the brother of ʿAli ibn Muhammad al-Farisi, whose mention has preceded.
translations.ur: ابو محمد، علی بن محمد الفارسی کے بھائی، جن کا ذکر پہلے گزر چکا ہے۔
translations.tr: Ebü Muhammed, daha önce zikri geçen Ali ibn Muhammed el-Fârisî'nin kardeşi.
translations.fa: ابومحمد، برادرِ علی بن محمد فارسی، که ذکر او پیش‌تر گذشت.
translations.id: Abu Muhammad, saudara ʿAli ibn Muhammad al-Farisi, yang penyebutannya telah didahulukan.
translations.bn: আবু মুহাম্মদ, ʿআলি ইবন মুহাম্মদ আল-ফারিসির ভাই, যার উল্লেখ পূর্বে এসেছে।
translations.es: Abu Muhammad, el hermano de ʿAli ibn Muhammad al-Farisi, cuya mención ha precedido.
translations.fr: Abu Muhammad, le frère de ʿAli ibn Muhammad al-Farisi, dont il a été fait mention précédemment.
translations.de: Abu Muhammad, der Bruder von ʿAli ibn Muhammad al-Farisi, dessen Erwähnung zuvor erfolgt ist.
translations.ru: Абу Мухаммад, брат ʿАли ибн Мухаммада аль-Фариси, о котором уже упоминалось ранее.
translations.zh: 阿布·穆罕默德，ʿ阿里·伊本·穆罕默德·法尔西的兄弟，其前文已提及。

en.summary: This text is a brief biographical identification of a person named Abu Muhammad. It clarifies his relation to ʿAli ibn Muhammad al-Farisi by stating that he is his brother and that the latter was mentioned earlier.
en.seo_question: Who is Abu Muhammad in relation to ʿAli ibn Muhammad al-Farisi?

key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ: The named individual to whom Abu Muhammad is related.
key_terms.ذِكْرُهُ: His mention; referring to an earlier reference in the text.

ur.seo_question: ابو محمد کا علی بن محمد الفارسی سے کیا تعلق ہے؟
